notes: INSIDE half of the Laser Mk2: three steel capacitors, repair hatch, power coupling, 5-cell strip plus a second row of magenta pips (the Mk2 accent). charge: frame round(fraction*5), 5 = ready; fire: strip discharge. Barrel layer laser_mk2_barrel: twin emitter rails with a fork gap, magenta trim; damaged: rail cracked, lower emitter cap hangs by a wire; disabled: the top rail snaps and droops into the fork. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
